promotion.scope: Explicit workspace mutation DEV preview only; controlled performance promotion pending

private_qualification.scope: Exact clean pushed source Core; Node/Bun/Deno bounded persistent Alpine shell mkdir, child file pipeline, failure recovery and cleanup; not full Alpine compatibility

public_qualification.scope: Fresh G5 four-platform packages and source-free matrix required; no inherited G4 qualification

distribution.revision_policy: Resolve main to its 40-hex public Git commit, then fetch manifest, Core, Host and fixture using that SAME commit. Never fetch Wasm from a moving CDN ref.
distribution.current_files_policy: One current Core per channel; replace in place after existing qualification, history via Git commits. No rebuild or implicit promotion.

fetch.scope: optional preopened HTTP service, not sockets

capability_profile.name: explicit-workspace-preview
capability_profile.scope: Explicit in-memory workspace mutation only; no Host filesystem/network/thread/memfd grants
